statements.statement: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate the patient's recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope with potential paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia.
The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to detect rhythm disturbances during these episodes.
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
